name: C programming
offTopic: Java, Python, C++ classes, object-oriented programming (inheritance, abstract methods, interfaces), closures, lambdas, garbage collection and functional programming are NOT part of a C course.

rules: Sizes of int, long, pointers etc. are implementation-defined: the C standard only gives minimum ranges (int at least 16 bits) and sizeof(char) == 1. A question that needs a size must state it (e.g. 'assume int is 4 bytes').
Format specifiers must match the type (%d int, %ld long, %u unsigned, %f float/double in printf, %lf double in scanf, %c char, %s string, %p pointer).
Declaration (int x;), initialization (int x = 5; a value given in the declaration) and assignment (x = 5; a later statement) are different things and must not be mixed up.
Integer division truncates toward zero; mixing int and float follows the usual arithmetic conversions.
Check precedence and associativity in every expression (e.g. * before +, == before &&, assignment right to left).
Modifying a variable twice without a sequence point (i = i++ + ++i; printf("%d %d", i, i++);) is undefined behaviour: it has no single correct output and must not be asked as an output question.
Pre-increment returns the new value, post-increment the old value.
&& and || short-circuit; the result of a relational or logical operator is int 0 or 1.

The token kinds are keywords, identifiers, constants, string literals, operators and punctuators (special symbols). C89 has 32 keywords; C99 adds 5 and C11 adds 7: say which standard if a count is asked.
Identifiers: letters, digits and underscore, not starting with a digit, case-sensitive, not a keyword.
Indices run from 0 to size-1; reading or writing outside is undefined behaviour, not a guaranteed error or garbage value.
Memory of an array = number of elements × sizeof(element) (state the element size if a number is expected).
2-D arrays are stored row-major; a[i][j] is the element in row i, column j.
A string needs room for the terminating '\0'.
& gives an address, * in a declaration declares a pointer, * in an expression dereferences it. Keep the pointer, the pointer variable and the object pointed to distinct.
Pointer arithmetic moves by the size of the pointed-to type; it is only valid inside one array (or one past its end).
Dereferencing NULL, an uninitialised or a freed pointer is undefined behaviour.
Never claim pointers always make programs faster; passing a pointer avoids copying a large object, that is all.
Distinguish declaration (prototype), definition and call; parameters (in the definition) and arguments (in the call).
C passes arguments by value; 'call by reference' in C means passing a pointer.
Local (automatic) variables live until the block ends; static locals keep their value between calls; globals have file scope.
A recursive function needs a base case.
The textbook layout (documentation, link/preprocessor section, definitions, global declarations, main, user-defined functions) is a convention; only main() is required for a hosted program.
#include and #define are preprocessor directives, handled before compilation; a macro is text substitution, not a function call.
main returns int; void main() is not standard C.

The stages are preprocessing (directives, macros, includes → expanded source), compilation (source → assembly), assembly (assembly → object code), linking (object files + libraries → executable), then loading and execution.
Never use compiler, interpreter, assembler and linker interchangeably; C is compiled, not interpreted.
Syntax errors are found at compile time, undefined references at link time, and logic or runtime errors only when the program runs.
Every program shown must compile as standard C (headers included, declared before use, semicolons, matching braces) unless the question is about finding the error.
An output question must have exactly one correct output on any standard compiler: no undefined, unspecified or implementation-defined behaviour unless the needed assumption is stated.
Trace the program line by line and compare the exact printed text (spaces and newlines) with the key.

Indentation means nothing to C. Without braces, if/else/while/for control only the next single statement, and an else belongs to the nearest unmatched if (the dangling else). Re-indent the code by these rules before tracing it.
Integer division truncates (5 / 2 is 2); % takes the sign of the left operand; a char in arithmetic is its character code.
